mapper.sql: select m.menu_id as "menuId", m.parent_menu_id as "parentMenuId", m.menu_type as "menuType", m.menu_name as "menuName", m.display_order as "displayOrder", m.screen_id as "screenId", m.url as "url", m.icon as "icon", m.business_category as "businessCategory", m.description as "description", m.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", m.status as "status", m.change_reason as "changeReason", m.updated_at as "updatedAt" from menus m
mapper.select:
m.status != 'DELETED'
and (m.menu_name ilike concat('%', #{filter}, '%') or m.screen_id ilike concat('%', #{filter}, '%') or m.url ilike concat('%', #{filter}, '%'))
order by coalesce(m.parent_menu_id, 0), m.display_order, m.menu_id
select count(*) from menus where menu_id = #{menuId} and status != 'DELETED'

with recursive descendants as ( select menu_id from menus where parent_menu_id = #{ancestorMenuId} and status != 'DELETED' union all select child.menu_id from menus child join descendants parent on child.parent_menu_id = parent.menu_id where child.status != 'DELETED' ) select count(*) from descendants where menu_id = #{candidateMenuId}
mapper.update: update menus set parent_menu_id = #{parentMenuId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} where menu_id = #{menuId} and status != 'DELETED'
mapper.select:
m.status != 'DELETED'
and m.parent_menu_id = #{parentMenuId}
and m.parent_menu_id is null
order by m.display_order, m.menu_id
